title: 第19章 种子序列第20章 十日考核
content_zh:
教官的目光陡然变得凌厉起来。
“但炼皮，难。”
“营养膏、异兽肉，只能给你们提供气血和能量。”
“想要炼皮，必须真正地‘调用气血’，引导气血冲刷体表。这需要极高的身体掌控力，也就是世俗所谓的悟性。”
“当初武道初兴盛，以学院教习为主，是让你们闭关打坐，去冥想，去感悟气血的流动。”
教官突然发出一声充满嘲弄的冷嗤。
“蠢钝至极。联邦前线每天都在死人，帝国没有时间等你们十年！”
“军方的做法，简单粗暴且有效。”
教官抬起手，直指下方两万余名新兵，“在生死边缘，在极度的痛楚与高压下，肉身为求自保，会本能地将气血逼向体表防御。”
“你们没有悟性，军方就用拳头，把调用气血变成你们的生理本能！”
“故而，今日没有体能拉练。”
督战队的士兵整齐划一地拉动枪栓，冰冷的金属碰撞声响彻广场。
教官冷酷的军令如重锤般砸下：
“今日，依旧是实战对练。”
“主脑已根据你们这五日的测验数据、抗压表现以及伤病恢复情况，下发了匹配名单。”
“实力相近者，捉对厮杀。势均力敌的生死搏杀，最能把你们体内的气血逼出来。”
“看你们的手环，去对应的区域。”
“不用留手，打断骨头，医疗区管治。把你们对面的人当成虚空里的虫子，全力一战，听懂了吗！”
“是！”
震耳欲聋的嘶吼声在广场上爆发。经过这五日的折磨，新兵们早已明白，退缩只有死路一条。

江岳站在人群中，面色平静。
教官的一番话，彻底印证了他这段时间身体发生的变化。
难怪随着力量的提升，骨骼与肌肉的负荷感越来越重。
一千公斤是凡胎的承载极限，而他依靠【韧皮】词条，实际上已经在用最粗暴的路径跨越这道悟性门槛。
“这种训练，简直像是将一筐鸡蛋往墙上砸，没碎的便是成材了...”
江岳心中暗叹一句，这些天里不知练废了多少人，若非面板在身，以他的身体素质恐怕也是难熬过去。
优胜劣汰，适者生存，宇宙法则如此，却也无奈。
“结队，开始！”
随着一声令下，方阵轰然散开。
相比于几天前第一次实战对练时的混乱与犹豫，今天的新兵们显得极具攻击性。
为了打破力量的壁垒，为了跨入一级武者的门槛，所有人都渴望那种拳拳到肉的高压刺激。
江岳深吸一口气，【顺气】词条悄然运转。
经过昨夜异兽血精的洗礼，他现在的气血底蕴已今非昔比。
寒风如刀。
主脑系统开始运转，基于两日前的基础素质摸底测验数据，为全员进行强制匹配。
实力相近者成组，以求最大化压榨新兵的实战潜能。
content_en:
The instructor's eyes suddenly became sharp.
"But leather refining is difficult."
"Nutritional ointment and exotic animal meat can only provide you with blood and energy."
"If you want to refine skin, you must truly 'call on the Qi and blood' and guide the Qi and blood to flush the body surface. This requires extremely high body control, which is what the world calls understanding."
"When martial arts first flourished, the focus was on academy teaching, which allowed you to sit in seclusion, meditate, and understand the flow of qi and blood."
The instructor suddenly let out a mocking sneer.
"Extremely stupid. People are dying on the federal frontline every day. The Empire doesn't have time to wait for you for ten years!"
"The military's approach is simple, crude and effective."
The instructor raised his hand and pointed directly at the more than 20,000 recruits below, "On the edge of life and death, under extreme pain and high pressure, in order to protect itself, the body will instinctively force blood and energy to the surface of the body for defense."
"You have no understanding, so the military will use fists to turn the use of qi and blood into your physiological instinct!"
"Therefore, there is no physical training today."
The soldiers of the supervising team pulled the bolts of their guns uniformly, and the sound of cold metal collision echoed throughout the square.
The instructor's cold military order hit like a heavy hammer:
"Today, it is still a practical sparring session."
"The mastermind has issued a matching list based on your test data, pressure resistance performance, and injury recovery over the past five days."
"Those with similar strength should fight against each other. An evenly matched life and death fight is the best way to force the blood out of your body."
"Look at your bracelets and go to the corresponding area."
"Don't hold back, break the bones, the medical area will take care of you. Treat the people opposite you as bugs in the void, fight with all your strength, do you understand?"
"Yes!"
A deafening roar erupted in the square. After these five days of torture, the recruits had already understood that retreating would lead to death.
Jiang Yue stood in the crowd with a calm expression.
The instructor's words completely confirmed the changes in his body during this period.
No wonder that as strength increases, the load on bones and muscles becomes heavier and heavier.
One thousand kilograms is the carrying limit of a mortal body, and relying on the [bast] entry, he has actually used the roughest path to cross this threshold of understanding.
"This kind of training is like smashing a basket of eggs against the wall. The ones that are not broken are the ones that are useful..."
Jiang Yue secretly sighed in his heart. He didn't know how many people had been defeated in these days. If it weren't for the face plate, it would be difficult for him to survive given his physical condition.
Survival of the fittest, survival of the fittest, this is the law of the universe, but it is helpless.
"Team up and start!"
With an order, the phalanx dispersed.
Compared to the confusion and hesitation during the first actual sparring session a few days ago, today's recruits looked extremely aggressive.
In order to break the barrier of strength and cross the threshold of a first-level warrior, everyone longs for the high-pressure stimulation of punching to the flesh.
Jiang Yue took a deep breath, and the [Shunqi] entry was quietly running.
After being baptized by the blood essence of the alien beast last night, his current energy and blood foundation is no longer what it used to be.
The cold wind is like a knife.
The main brain system started to operate, and based on the basic quality test data two days ago, forced matching was performed for all members.
Those with similar strengths are grouped together in order to maximize the actual combat potential of the recruits.
